cohort: 199 neonates born through CD at Limbe Regional Hospital (LRH) and Buea Regional Hospital (BRH), Cameroon
finding: The study found a high prevalence of adverse neonatal outcomes (ANO) associated with CD, particularly for emergency indications and when CPD was the indication.
mod_finding: Emergency indications for CD were associated with more adverse neonatal outcomes compared to elective indications.
